subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should `sessions.list.presentation` become the supported long-term Gateway contract for client-ready session titles, classification, and background state?
rationale: The patch is additive, but it establishes a new cross-client protocol surface with generated native models; code review cannot determine which session metadata must remain stable for third-party clients.

options.title: Adopt the additive presentation contract
options.body: Approve the optional object with open string classifications, then require a rebased live producer proof before merging.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Limit the first public shape to the fields maintainers are prepared to support permanently and defer the rest until clients need them.

options.title: Defer the API
options.body: Keep the underlying issue open and postpone this public protocol surface until a broader client-contract decision is made.

recommendation.title: Adopt the additive presentation contract
recommendation.body: Approve the optional object with open string classifications, then require a rebased live producer proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository context identifies this member as the recent contributor coordinating the Gateway proposal and native consumer work.
